title.vi: Needn't have vs didn't need to
title.en: Needn't have vs didn't need to

header.native_title: Needn't have vs didn't need to

summary.vi: Phân biệt needn't have + quá khứ phân từ (việc đã làm nhưng không cần thiết) với didn't need to + động từ nguyên mẫu (không có sự cần thiết, không cho biết việc có xảy ra hay không).
summary.en: Distinguish needn't have + past participle (something was done but was unnecessary) from didn't need to + base verb (there was no necessity, without saying whether the action happened).

sub.vi: không cần thiết trong quá khứ

when_to_use.vi: Dùng needn't have + quá khứ phân từ khi bạn biết chắc hành động đã xảy ra và muốn nói nó không cần thiết.
when_to_use.en: Use needn't have + past participle when you know for certain the action happened and you want to say it was unnecessary.

when_to_use.vi: Dùng didn't need to + động từ nguyên mẫu khi chỉ muốn nói không có sự cần thiết, không quan tâm việc đó có được làm hay không.
when_to_use.en: Use didn't need to + base verb when you only want to say there was no necessity, without saying whether the action was done.

when_to_use.vi: Dùng needn't have khi muốn thể hiện sự tiếc nuối hoặc phê bình nhẹ rằng ai đó đã làm việc không cần thiết.
when_to_use.en: Use needn't have to express mild regret or criticism that someone did something unnecessary.

when_to_use.vi: Dùng didn't need to khi kể lại tình huống trong quá khứ mà không có nghĩa vụ, thường đi kèm lý do như because, so.
when_to_use.en: Use didn't need to to narrate a past situation with no obligation, often with a reason such as because or so.

label.vi: trợ động từ phủ định + have

examples.text: You needn't have brought food; we had plenty.

annotation.vi: Hành động mang thức ăn đã xảy ra, nhưng không cần thiết.
annotation.en: The action of bringing food happened, but it was unnecessary.

translation.vi: Bạn đã không cần mang thức ăn; chúng tôi có nhiều rồi.
translation.en: You didn't need to bring food; we had plenty.

examples.text: I didn't need to work yesterday because it was a holiday.

annotation.vi: Không có sự cần thiết phải làm việc; không cho biết tôi có làm hay không.
annotation.en: There was no necessity to work; it does not say whether I worked.

translation.vi: Hôm qua tôi không cần làm việc vì là ngày nghỉ.
translation.en: I didn't need to work yesterday because it was a holiday.

examples.text: She needn't have paid for a taxi.

annotation.vi: Cô ấy đã trả tiền taxi, nhưng việc đó không cần thiết.
annotation.en: She paid for a taxi, but it was unnecessary.

translation.vi: Cô ấy đã không cần trả tiền taxi.
translation.en: She needn't have paid for a taxi.

reason.vi: Sau needn't phải có have + quá khứ phân từ, không dùng quá khứ đơn.
reason.en: After needn't you need have + past participle, not the past simple.

quick_practice.q: You ___ have brought food; we had plenty.

explain.vi: Hành động mang thức ăn đã xảy ra, nên dùng needn't have + quá khứ phân từ.
explain.en: The action of bringing food happened, so use needn't have + past participle.

quick_practice.q: I ___ work yesterday because it was a holiday.

explain.vi: Chỉ nói không có sự cần thiết, không cho biết việc có xảy ra hay không, nên dùng didn't need to + động từ nguyên mẫu.
explain.en: It only says there was no necessity, without saying whether the action happened, so use didn't need to + base verb.

quick_practice.q: She needn't have ___ for a taxi.

explain.vi: Sau needn't have phải dùng quá khứ phân từ, không dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.
explain.en: After needn't have you need the past participle, not the base verb.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu về một việc bạn đã làm trong quá khứ nhưng không cần thiết, dùng needn't have + quá khứ phân từ.
prompt.en: Write a sentence about something you did in the past that was unnecessary, using needn't have + past participle.

sample.text: I needn't have bought so much milk.

corrections.issue: The R5 lesson lists 'I didn't need to have called, so I didn't call.' as a mistake, but it is grammatically possible and not a real learner error for this point.
corrections.fix: Removed it from common_mistakes and replaced it with the genuine error 'I needn't bought it.' -> 'I needn't have bought it.'

corrections.issue: The R5 lesson gives no formula, no negative/question forms, no spans, no comparison, and no quick practice.
corrections.fix: Added the formula with slots and roles, empty negative/question arrays (the point has no distinct negative or question form), spans for all examples, and three quick-practice questions.

corrections.issue: The R5 example 'We didn't need to book in advance.' is correct but the lesson does not explain that it does not say whether the booking happened.
corrections.fix: Kept the meaning in the summary and when_to_use, and used a parallel example 'I didn't need to work yesterday because it was a holiday.' with an annotation making that point explicit.
